violations.description: Hardcoded API key in workflow env block
violations.evidence: Line 15 defines API_KEY with a literal string.
violations.recommendation: Remove the hardcoded secret and use GitHub Secrets with the `secrets:` context.

violations.evidence: The auto-label workflow uses ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} and checks out the PR code.
violations.recommendation: Use a safer trigger (like pull_request) or do not check out code from an untrusted source.

violations.description: Deployment step has no gating tests or validation
violations.evidence: manual-deploy.yml performs a deploy without testing requirements.
violations.recommendation: Ensure deployment job has a `needs:` constraint on a test job.

violations.description: Untrusted input in shell script via interpolation
violations.evidence: The greet-pr workflow interpolates PR title and username directly into a script command.
violations.recommendation: Use environment variables to handle input safely, never interpolate directly into command strings.

violations.description: Untrusted inputs in manual-deploy workflow command execution
violations.evidence: Inputs version and environment are interpolated directly into a shell run command.
violations.recommendation: Use environment variables to map inputs to the script to prevent command injection.

violations.evidence: package.json exists but package-lock.json is missing.
violations.recommendation: Run `npm install` and commit the generated `package-lock.json` file.

violations.evidence: No .gitignore file in the root directory.
violations.recommendation: Add a .gitignore file to exclude build artifacts, dependencies, and environment files.
